readme_excerpt: Protocol Buffers - Google's data interchange format Copyright 2008 Google LLC Overview Protocol Buffers (a.k.a., protobuf) are Google's language-neutral, platform-neutral, extensible mechanism for serializing structured data. You can learn more about it in protobuf's documentation. This README file contains protobuf installation instructions.
